summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError, and test/test_extras/test_extras_shacl.py. The new tests and test/test_path.py pass together (41 passed), run with the prepared venv from the generated directory. No existing files were modified and nothing was committed. Not verified: black, isort and mypy are not in the prepared venv and were not installed, so formatting and type-ignore placement were checked by reading only. Lines are under 88 columns. Choices: None and plain strings raise SHACLPathError before any graph lookup; literals raise TypeError; modifiers use three explicit branches with literal "*", "+", "?". The empty-sequence case is unreachable separately because () is rdf:nil, so the () test covers the rdf:nil error only.
